name: Jiangsu Allfavor Intelligent Circuits Technology CO.,Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Allfavor Intelligent Circuits Technology CO.,Ltd specializes in the production and distribution of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their extensive product catalog features a wide range of circuit board types, including single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer designs. They also provide advanced options such as thick copper plates, multi-functional metal substrates, flexible circuits, rigid-flex boards, and high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, complemented by their technical expertise. These solutions are critical components across diverse sectors, including telecommunications, automotive, power management, general electronics, healthcare, and defense. The company was established in 2006 and operates from its primary base in Nanjing, China.
